description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] Is this website up or down? One live request to a URL with no redirect following: up or down (and why: DNS, timeout, refused, TLS), status, Location, timings in ms for DNS, TCP connect, TLS handshake, time to first byte and total, IP, HTTP version, server header. Measured from Malaysia. Never cached. ~0.1-2 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

url.description: URL to ping: a public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com

name: http_ping

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: HTTP ping: is a website up or down? Status and timings (DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB) ($0.002/call)
